correctness.rationale: From the exact inverse-Gaussian density, the log ratio is A/t+Bt+C. Its monotone or convex sign pattern proves the full stochastic-order and unique transversal-crossing alternatives for all positive L, v_i and D_i. A strict Gaussian Mills bound proves t_c>L/v at common drift, while a locally uniform scaled-survival expansion and derivative-ratio monotonicity prove the unique v^2 t_c limit. The independent Python checker reproduces the formulas in hundreds of bounded tests, but the infinite-domain statements rest on the written proofs.

value.rationale: Field breakthrough detection concerns cumulative recovery at arbitrary time, not only mean passage time. The theorem gives sharp physical parameter inequalities under which every monitoring cutoff has the same arrival ranking; outside that region the ranking reverses exactly once. Its explicit v^{-2} singular scaling and strict post-mean crossover address a natural transport boundary missed by zero-drift monotonicity, providing a reproducible analytic diagnostic.
